name: HitMagic
description: CLASS/PLAYER bypass ability for hitting magical creatures. get_user_ability_value(0x8e, player) in attack_user_monster sums the player's class HitMagic(142) plus any equipped items with HitMagic(142). This total is subtracted from the monster's Magical(28) requirement BEFORE the weapon is checked. If class+item HitMagic >= monster requirement, the weapon needs no Magical(28) at all. NOTE: Items with HitMagic(142) only (no Magical(28)) are NOT blocked by the Witchunter AntiMagic check — making them the only way for Witchunters to bypass magical creature gates beyond their class bonus.
dllNotes: attack_user_monster @ 0x42cfab: get_user_ability_value(0x8e, param_1, 0, 0, NULL) called after monster Magical requirement is accumulated. Return value subtracted from local_2c (requirement). If local_2c reaches 0 → no weapon magic check needed. If still > 0, unarmed (fists/kicks) are blocked outright; weapon must have Magical(28) >= remainder. The DLL does NOT call has_ability(0x8e) — it uses get_user_ability_value — which is why this ability does not appear in the has_ability() call survey.

dllNotes: user_can_use @ 0x41fced: if player has AntiMagic(51/0x33), scans item ability array (item+0x2f6..+0x3d4, 20 slots) for ability 0x1c — returns false (blocks equip/wear/wield). attack_user_monster @ 0x42cfab: monster known_data ability loop reads 0x1c value as required magic level (local_2c). After class HitMagic(142) is subtracted, checks weapon via get_item_ability_value(0x1c, weapon, 0) — weapon Magical must meet remaining requirement. Items that carry ONLY HitMagic(142) and no Magical(28) are NOT blocked by the AntiMagic check.

dllNotes: FUN_00429ceb @ 0x429ceb (called from attack_user_monster): get_monster_ability_value(0x9e, 0, known_data, monster_data) — if 0, pass. If monster has value N: player must have a weapon equipped AND get_item_ability_value(0x9e, weapon, 0) must equal N EXACTLY (strict equality, not >=). Unarmed always fails. No class ability can bypass this gate. Spell-side equivalent: FUN_00429d40 @ 0x429d40 in cast_monster_target performs the same exact-match check against spell ability 0x9e.
